// REQ: LANG-1221 LANG-1222 LANG-1223 LANG-1224
/* Block comment */
type shape =
  | Circle(float)
  | Rect(float, float);

let area = shape =>
  switch (shape) {
  | Circle(r) => 3.14 *. r *. r
  | Rect(w, h) => w *. h
  };

let identity: 'a => 'a = x => x;

[@react.component]
let make = (~name) => {
  let greeting = "Hello, " ++ name ++ "!\n";
  let quoted = {|raw "text" \n stays|};
  let c = 'x';
  Js.log(greeting ++ quoted ++ String.make(1, c));
  <div> {React.string("hi")} </div>;
};

let rec fib = n => n < 2 ? n : fib(n - 1) + fib(n - 2);
let ok = true && !false && Some(0x1F) != None;
